Name: docker.io/library/mariadb
Notes: MariaDB for Matomo and the image of its backup job, deployed only when matomo.enable is true. Pinned by digest; inv_addons.digital-energy-twin.matomo.db_image can override it, for example with a mirror.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg-web-adminfrontend
Notes: Admin frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg-web-backend
Notes: Backend image used for database migration and application runtime; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg-web-frontend
Notes: Public frontend image deployed by the addon; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ghcr.io/csi-foxbyte/regensburg-web-matomo
Notes: Matomo web analytics image with the LoginOIDC and NoPasswordReset plugins, built from images/matomo and pinned in vars/matomo_image.json, deployed when inv_addons.digital-energy-twin.matomo.enable is true; its verified, digest-bound SBOM is maintained as a modular child BOM.

Name: ansible-core
Notes: Executes the addon playbook; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

Name: Apache APISIX
Relationship: required application gateway and policy integration
Notes: Routes frontend and backend traffic and enforces OIDC, role, CORS, rate-limit, and response-header policies; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

Name: cert-manager
Notes: Issues certificates for the selected annotated Ingress or Gateway resources through the configured cluster issuer. Gateway API support is required only in Gateway routing mode; the version is supplied by the platform.

Name: Civitas Core
Notes: The addon consumes Civitas Core inventory, shared access tasks, and platform services; the host version is selected by the deployment.

Name: ingress-nginx
Notes: An existing ingress-nginx deployment can route the three addon hosts to APISIX in Ingress routing mode. The addon selects the IngressClass via inv_k8s.ingress_class and does not install the controller; the controller version is supplied by the platform.

Name: jmespath
Notes: Required by the Ansible json_query filter used to select Keycloak clients; the version is supplied by the control environment.

Name: Keycloak
Relationship: required identity and access management integration
Notes: Provides the OIDC client, roles, client secret, discovery metadata, and token introspection used by the application; the version is supplied by Civitas Core.

Name: Kubernetes
Notes: Runs the Deployments, Services, Secrets, ConfigMaps, and selected Ingress or Gateway/HTTPRoute resources created by the addon; the cluster version is deployment-specific.

Name: kubernetes.core
Notes: Provides the k8s and k8s_info modules used throughout the addon; the version is supplied by the Civitas Core control environment.

Name: PostgreSQL
Notes: Stores backend application data in a database provisioned on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster, or in a separately managed existing database; the server version is deployment-specific.

Name: Traefik
Notes: Civitas Core uses Traefik as its reference Gateway API controller. Gateway routing mode selects the platform controller via inv_k8s.gateway_class and routes the addon hosts to APISIX using Gateways and HTTPRoutes; Ingress mode can use the existing platform Ingress controller instead. The controller version is supplied by the platform.

Name: Zalando Postgres Operator
Notes: Reconciles the acid.zalan.do/v1 postgresql resource used to provision the addon database on central-db or another existing Zalando cluster; not used in existing-database mode.
